posts.text: drop me into an international peace summit and i'll be the delegate who stands up and asks why we are signing a treaty during mercury retrograde. history will thank me
posts.caption: nothing gets signed until mercury goes direct. not even the guestbook

posts.text: please be advised that all texts sent by me during mercury retrograde are considered drafts and are not legally binding. this includes 'i miss you', 'we should get dinner' and 'i'm five minutes away'
posts.caption: my lawyer is also retrograde, please be patient

posts.text: i have formally submitted a ticket to IT asking whether the server outage is related to mercury retrograde. they have not responded, which honestly confirms everything
posts.caption: the ticket is still open. so is my third eye

posts.text: very responsible of me to back up my phone, triple check my flights and reread every email twice, and still text my ex happy birthday on the wrong day because mercury was retrograde
posts.caption: preparation is no match for the messenger planet walking backwards

posts.text: in light of mercury retrograde, i have suspended all major purchases, contract signings and any conversation that begins with 'we need to talk'. normal miscommunication will resume shortly x
posts.caption: thank you for your patience during this cosmic maintenance window

posts.text: put me in charge of nasa and i will not launch a single rocket until mercury goes direct. the moon has been there for four billion years. it can wait three weeks
posts.caption: space isn't going anywhere. neither is my shadow period

posts.text: mercury retrograde is a time to reflect, review and revisit. so i have reflected on my ex, reviewed our old texts and am now revisiting a decision the universe already rejected in writing
posts.caption: the three r's, exactly as the cosmos intended

posts.text: my out of office for the next three weeks: thank you for your email. mercury is currently retrograde, so i will be misreading it, replying to the wrong person and apologising sometime next month
posts.caption: auto reply active until the post shadow period ends

posts.text: put me in a medieval castle and i'll be the court astrologer warning the king that the royal wedding cannot happen until mercury goes direct. the messenger keeps getting lost and frankly i called it
posts.caption: for the record, the dragon was also mercury retrograde

posts.text: it is with great humility that i accept full responsibility for nothing that happened during mercury retrograde. the planet of communication was walking backwards and, regrettably, so was i
posts.caption: statement released. no further questions until it stations direct

posts.text: everyone warns you about mercury retrograde but nobody talks about the post shadow period, the two weeks where it's technically over but my inbox is still behaving like a crime scene
posts.caption: pre shadow, retrograde, post shadow. a trilogy nobody asked for

posts.text: my landlord asked why the rent was late so i explained that mercury retrograde rules technology, contracts and banking. he did not find this helpful but i found it very freeing
posts.caption: financially questionable, astrologically correct

posts.text: my venus in pisces would like to apologise to you, forgive you and write you a poem. my mars in aries would like to inform you that the poem has been rescinded
posts.caption: one planet writes the letter, the other one burns it

posts.text: put me in a couples therapy session and i will ask the therapist to pull up both our mars placements before anyone says a word. we are not discussing feelings until i know how everyone fights
posts.caption: mars rules conflict. i'm simply doing the intake paperwork

posts.text: an internal investigation has found that my venus in cancer cooked him dinner three times this week and my mars in capricorn logged it in a spreadsheet. both departments are being restructured
posts.caption: love language: home cooking with quarterly reporting

posts.text: my venus wants a slow burn romance with handwritten letters and a meet cute in a bookshop. my mars wants to win the argument we haven't had yet. they share one apartment and it's me
posts.caption: two planets, one lease, zero peace

posts.text: my venus in virgo does not fall in love. it finds one tiny flaw, writes a detailed improvement plan for it and then falls deeply in love with the improvement plan
posts.caption: romance is just project management with candles

posts.text: if venus is how you love and mars is how you fight, then my chart is basically a rom com where the main character cries at the airport and then sues the airline
posts.caption: venus in libra, mars in scorpio, now in cinemas

posts.text: send me to the olympics and i won't be competing, i'll be in the stands explaining that the gold medallist clearly has mars in leo and the silver has mars in libra and just hated the conflict
posts.caption: mars in libra will let you win to keep the peace

posts.text: a gentle reminder that my venus is in taurus, which means i will love you loyally, slowly and forever. it also means that if you eat the last of my snacks, that is a lifetime ban x
posts.caption: loyal, sensual, stubborn. the snacks are in the contract

posts.text: after careful deliberation, my mars in gemini has chosen to settle this argument the only way it knows how: a 47 slide presentation, three screenshots and a voice note that starts with 'okay so'
posts.caption: mars in gemini fights with words. so many words

posts.text: my venus in aquarius loves you deeply, but in a detached, humanitarian way, the same way it loves public libraries and the concept of clean water. please take this as the compliment it is
posts.caption: venus in aquarius loves you like a cause it supports

posts.text: my rising sign is out here closing deals and shaking hands like a seasoned diplomat, while my moon sign is sitting in the car crying to a song from 2014 about a guy i have never met
posts.caption: front of house: executive. back of house: pisces moon

posts.text: put me in a job interview and i'll be wondering whether the hiring manager's coldness is a capricorn rising thing or a capricorn moon thing, because only one of those i can work with
posts.caption: the rising is the receptionist. the moon is the ceo

posts.text: i have appointed my leo rising as head of public relations, my cancer moon as head of internal feelings, and my virgo sun as the only one in the building doing any actual work
posts.caption: big three, small staff, endless meetings

posts.text: on the first date you will meet my libra rising. on the third date you will meet my scorpio moon. by then the libra rising will have already signed the nda on your behalf x
posts.caption: the rising is the lobby. the moon is the vault

posts.text: please direct all complaints about my personality to my moon sign. my rising sign is merely the spokesperson and has been instructed to smile, nod and say 'no comment'
posts.caption: the rising does press. the moon does damage control

posts.text: very aries moon of me to be emotionally fine, then devastated, then completely over it, all within one elevator ride between the second and fourth floors
posts.caption: aries moon processes feelings in under ninety seconds

posts.text: i've reached the age where a stranger asks my sign and i respond with my full big three, my venus, my chiron and a brief history of my eighth house. they wanted one word
posts.caption: the sun sign is the trailer. i give the director's cut

posts.text: my taurus moon is legally a separate entity from the rest of my chart. it does not attend parties, does not answer calls after 9pm and will not discuss its feelings without a snack
posts.caption: comfort is not a preference. it's policy

posts.text: my saturn return is not a crisis, it is a scheduled performance review from the universe. i have prepared a slideshow, rehearsed my answers and will still be demoted to character development
posts.caption: saturn returns every 29 years. it does not do grade inflation

posts.text: in accordance with my saturn return, i have quit the job, ended the situationship and moved my entire life into a storage unit. saturn calls this growth. the storage company calls me a valued customer
posts.caption: the late twenties starter pack, as approved by saturn

posts.text: an astrologer read my birth chart, went quiet for eleven seconds, then said 'interesting'. i have thought about those eleven seconds every day since and i would like a second opinion and a lawyer
posts.caption: the scariest word in astrology is 'interesting'

posts.text: full moon tonight so i'm releasing everything that no longer serves me, which includes three group chats, one man named kyle and a gym membership i have used exactly twice
posts.caption: the moon handles the energy. i handle the cancellations

posts.text: eclipse season is coming, so i will be cancelling plans, avoiding big decisions and acting shocked when the universe fires me from a situation i was already quietly packing up to leave
posts.caption: eclipses only take what you were already holding loosely

posts.text: saturn is in aries now, which means the universe has officially merged discipline with impatience. so i will be building a solid, sustainable five year plan by friday or quitting entirely
posts.caption: saturn in aries: hard work, but make it immediately

posts.text: new moon intentions: be more patient, answer emails, drink water, stop reading my ex's horoscope. new moon results: one out of four, and i will not be disclosing which one
posts.caption: the new moon plants seeds. some of mine are plastic

posts.text: sitting at my own birth chart reading asking the astrologer if there's anything they can do about my twelfth house, the way you ask a mechanic to make that weird noise go away
posts.caption: twelfth house: secrets, hidden things and that noise

posts.text: i would like to formally notify the universe that i have reviewed its last three signs and found them unclear. going forward, please send all messages in writing, with a heading and a date
posts.caption: angel numbers are lovely but i need it as a pdf

posts.text: after months of manifesting, the universe has finally sent me a sign. it was a parking ticket. i am choosing to interpret this as an invitation to slow down and stay a while
posts.caption: abundance comes in many forms, mostly paperwork

posts.text: it has come to my attention that the law of attraction does not accept 'i guess it would be nice' as a valid manifestation. i have resubmitted with confidence, a vision board and a deadline
posts.caption: the universe has a very specific application process

posts.text: the simulation has issued me yet another side quest and frankly i am still waiting on the main storyline. please escalate this matter to whoever programmed my north node
posts.caption: north node: where i'm headed. side quests: where i actually am

posts.text: i saw 11:11 on the clock, 444 on a license plate and 333 on my receipt. so either my spirit guides are trying very hard to tell me something or the universe is just showing off that it can count
posts.caption: angel numbers, or the universe practicing its times tables

posts.text: per the terms of my agreement with the universe, i will keep my vibration high, journal every morning and stop saying 'with my luck'. in return, i expect a sudden, unexplained windfall by spring x
posts.caption: contracts are contracts, even the cosmic ones

posts.text: if the universe only gives us what we can handle, i would like it on record that i can handle a lake house, a book deal and a dog that has never once barked at night
posts.caption: testing the upper limits of what the universe thinks i can carry

posts.text: i have filed a formal bug report with the simulation. steps to reproduce: wake up, set an intention, get a text from my ex's mum. expected result: abundance. actual result: see above
posts.caption: status: open. priority: spiritual

posts.text: drop me onto the trading floor and i won't be reading charts, i'll be lighting a green candle and writing 'abundance' on a bay leaf until security gently escorts me out
posts.caption: it's called financial manifestation and it is not covered by insurance

posts.text: i've been told to act as if my manifestations have already come true, so i have stopped replying to emails, started calling everyone darling and asked my landlord to speak to my manager
posts.caption: living as my future self, who apparently has staff

posts.text: i'll need your full name, your date of birth and your exact time of birth before the appetisers arrive. if you don't know your birth time, that's fine, we can call your mum together right now
posts.caption: date one is technically an intake appointment

posts.text: after reviewing our synastry chart, i must inform you that your mars squares my moon, your saturn sits on my venus and the only thing we truly have in common is this restaurant
posts.caption: synastry results are in. the breadsticks were the highlight

posts.text: my friends ask what my type is and i say kind, funny, emotionally available. what i actually mean is someone whose venus trines my moon and who will not ask me what a trine is
posts.caption: standards are set by the stars and the stars are picky

posts.text: a red flag is when he says he doesn't believe in astrology. a crimson flag is when he doesn't know his birth time. a full parade is when he guesses 'probably morning'
posts.caption: please consult your birth certificate before consulting my heart

posts.text: put me on a dating show and i won't be choosing based on chemistry. i'll be pulling each contestant aside to ask about their seventh house and quietly eliminating anyone whose mars squares my sun
posts.caption: the rose ceremony is actually a synastry reading

posts.text: we've been talking for one week and i have already run our composite chart, read our davison chart and named the business we start together in 2031. he has not asked my last name
posts.caption: composite charts move faster than men do

posts.text: very romantic of me to fall in love at first sight, and very astrologer of me to check your chart in the bathroom before the main course to see if it's love or just a neptune transit
posts.caption: neptune in aries has everyone seeing things this year

posts.text: i'm not saying our relationship is doomed, but my mum looked at our synastry chart, took off her glasses and asked if i'd like her to light a candle for us or just for me
posts.caption: the family astrologer has spoken

posts.text: i have officially blocked a man for having his venus in the same sign as my ex's venus. some call it petty. i call it pattern recognition on a cosmic scale x
posts.caption: fool me once, fool me twice, not with the same venus sign

posts.text: please be advised that i am now accepting applications for a partner. requirements include a stable income, a sense of humour and a mars sign that won't start a war with mine over the dishwasher
posts.caption: mars compatibility is about who loads the dishwasher wrong

posts.text: i'm not looking for someone to finish my sentences. i'm looking for someone to finish their birth chart form, including time of birth, place of birth and a short personal statement on their saturn
posts.caption: please attach your natal chart as a pdf

posts.text: i'm coming to the wedding and i'm bringing a gift, but after looking at their synastry chart i'll be keeping the receipt and not buying anything engraved
posts.caption: love wins. the receipt is just in case
